gradedDisplay.inputs: src/assets/planet-sources/ (byte-identical copies of the previously served textures; not referenced by any page)
gradedDisplay.outputs: real-neptune.webp, real-neptune-morning.webp, real-earth-night.webp, real-earth-morning.webp, real-moon-night.webp, real-moon-morning.webp, real-saturn.webp, real-saturn-morning.webp (same pixel size, alpha unchanged)
gradedDisplay.note: The displayed textures are graded display versions of the same sources recorded below; the output sizes and hashes below describe the pre-grade source textures, and the current hashes are printed by the generator's manifest. The per-body daylight haze and chroma gains below are superseded by this grade.
gradedDisplay.lightSourcePreStep: chroma halved about each pixel's own luminance (removes the baked daytime chroma boost)

parameters.lighting: photograph unchanged (no re-lighting, no mirroring); native source resolution

parameters.matte: smoothstep(max(r,g,b), 6, 28) union the feathered ring ANNULUS (outer ring-plane ellipse minus the measured inner edge) union the oblate globe ellipse; connected component only. Empty space inside the inner edge and outside the globe is transparent.

ringInnerEdge.derivation: median over 90 lit sectors (|theta| < 60 degrees, outside the globe) of the smallest normalised radius with max(r,g,b) > 24, x 0.985

measurementOnlyGlobeExclusion.reason: globe-limb fringe contaminated the minimum (SATURN-ESTIMATOR-CONTAMINATION.json); the alpha globe silhouette is not dilated

parameters.lighting: photograph unchanged apart from the rotation

earth.law: Lambert, terminator softening 0.06, no atmosphere or cloud invention

moon.law: Lommel-Seeliger, albedo 0.78 x (0.75 luminance + 0.25 map colour)

saturnVisibility.source: alpha of the rendered real-saturn image

earthVisibility.source: alpha of the rendered real-earth image (identical in both themes)

earthDisplayTone.night: out = round(185 * (in / 255) ^ 0.72) per colour channel, interior and edge pixels with alpha > 0
earthDisplayTone.morning: retired: the former out = round(26 + 0.86 * in) curve is no longer applied; the day aerial-perspective mix below replaces it

dayAerialPerspective.transfer: standard sRGB (IEC 61966-2-1) decode and encode, linear-light mix
dayAerialPerspective.formula: m = (1 - k_body) * source_linear + k_body * sky_linear per channel; then chroma about the Rec. 709 linear luminance Y of m: out = Y + t * (m - Y), t = min(chromaGain_body, largest value keeping every channel within [0, 1]) (t >= 1), so luminance is unchanged
dayAerialPerspective.appliesTo: every pixel with alpha > 0 of real-neptune-morning, real-saturn-morning, real-earth-morning, real-moon-morning; alpha untouched, alpha 0 stays black
dayAerialPerspective.unchanged: real-neptune, real-saturn, real-earth-night, real-moon-night and both visibility masks
dayAerialPerspective.note: A fixed display grade toward the existing day sky colour; not true colour, not a different light, phase or source.

derived.note: Two alpha-only visibility masks are derived from the rendered Earth and Saturn alphas. Earth night display tone is a fixed grade applied after physical shading; day textures receive the aerial-perspective mix.

legacyNote.note: Two alpha-only visibility masks are derived from the rendered Earth and Saturn alphas. Earth display tone is a fixed grade applied after physical shading.

note: Illustrative off-world valley: real bodies, not a claim of an observer position. Neptune is feature-enhanced and not exact true colour; Earth and the Moon are map renders, not photographs.
